name: Pasak
title: Descendant of Asher
summary: Pasak was a descendant of Asher through the lineage of Japhlet. He is mentioned in 1 Chronicles in connection with the genealogies of the tribe of Asher. He is one of the many named descendants who helped maintain tribal identity in Israel.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Genealogy of Asher
keyEvents.description: Pasak is listed as one of the sons of Japhlet in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher. This register documents the important family lines within the tribe.

keyEvents.title: The Lineage of the Tribe of Asher
keyEvents.description: Pasak belonged to the tribe of Asher, one of the twelve tribes of Israel, and his name was preserved in the Chronicles' genealogies as part of the history of God's people.

keyEvents.title: Descendants of Japhlet
keyEvents.description: As the son of Japhlet, Pasach was part of a specific branch of the tribe of Asher. The sons of Japhlet included Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath according to some translations.

keyEvents.title: The Family Heads of the Tribe of Asher
keyEvents.description: The genealogy in 1 Chronicles describes the family heads of the tribe of Asher as skilled warriors and leaders, counted among the men of Israel.
